{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=Maners and life nothing amended, but much vvor{{ls}}e, {{ls}}ince this licentious to{{ls}}{{ls}}ing of holy Scriptures.}}If our nevv Mini{{ls}}ters had had this cogitation and care that the{{ls}}e and all other vvi{{ls}}e men haue, and euer had, our countrie had neuer fallen to this mi{{ls}}erable {{ls}}tate in religion, & that vnder pretence, colour, and coūtenance of Gods vvord: neither {{ls}}hould vertue and good life haue bene {{ls}}o pitifully corrupted in time of {{ls}}uch reading, toiling, tumbling and tran{{ls}}lating the booke of our life and {{ls}}aluation: vvhereof the more pretious the right and reuerent v{{ls}}e is, the more pernicious is the abu{{ls}}e and prophanation of the {{ls}}ame: vvhich euery man of experience by the{{ls}}e fevv yeres proofe, and by comparing the former daies and maners to the{{ls}}e of ours, may ea{{ls}}ily trie.
